name: 管理職員の特別勤務手当の対象時間を変更
summary: 現在、管理職員の特別勤務手当は、週休日等以外の日の午前0時から午前5時までの勤務が対象です。この議案で、対象時間を午後10時から翌日の午前5時までに改めます。ただし、週休日等に含まれる時間は除き、令和8年4月1日から施行します。
changes: 特別勤務手当の対象時間を午後10時から翌日の午前5時までに改める
人事委員会の承認を得て教育委員会規則で定める勤務について、手当額を定めた額の1.5倍にする
who: 管理職員として働く幼稚園教育職員
why: 管理職員に係る給与制度を改める必要があるためと、区は説明しています。

en.name: Changes the hours covered by special work allowances for managers
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance on the Salaries of Kindergarten Education Staff
en.summary: Currently, special work allowances for management staff apply to work from midnight to 5 a.m. on days other than weekly days off, etc. This bill changes the hours covered to 10 p.m. through 5 a.m. the following day. However, hours that fall on weekly days off, etc., are excluded. The ordinance takes effect on April 1, 2026.
changes: Changes the hours covered by special work allowances to 10 p.m. through 5 a.m. the following day
Sets the allowance for work specified by Board of Education rules with the approval of the personnel commission at 1.5 times the prescribed amount
who: Kindergarten education staff working as management staff
en.why: The ward says this is necessary to revise the salary system for management staff.
